correctness.rationale: The 10-case rank is explicit, exhaustive, nonnegative and strictly descends by 1 under the exactly derived integer-square map away from the two trap labels; this proves finite first entry for all nongrid points. Two exact formulas for T² prove primitive period 2 versus 4. Integer pair counts give 2k area on each consecutive parity shell and the generating function. The ten cases also imply |h-2(|m|+|n|)|<=3; coupling with independent coordinate moduli implies Wasserstein-1 bound <=7/R and triangular limit. Exact-rational checker supports but does not replace the infinite algebraic proof.

value.rationale: The original papers motivate the size of attracting limit sets for non-injective rotations, but not the time to reach them. The new exact global rank answers that natural missing transient question for a nontrivial surjective two-center quarter-turn system, yields an infinite but closed-form parity-paired area spectrum, and gives the macroscopic triangular capture-time law with finite-window quantitative error. It is a motivated full-dimensional global result, not an arbitrarily truncated computation or a simple rephrasing of an existing theorem.
